everything.group: APIs the live app calls · APIs que usa la app

items.name: OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe
items.does: Speech to text for visit recordings, through the Vercel AI SDK, tried after the AI Gateway as fallback.

items.name: OpenAI gpt-4o
items.does: Visit extraction, photo reading and the week card, through the Vercel AI SDK with fallback.

items.name: MedSeek PR API
items.does: Real provider directory for Puerto Rico. Thanks to MedSeek (Instagram @medseekpr).

items.name: ORCPS public license snapshot
items.does: Local backup of public provider licenses, used when the live directory is not available.

items.name: Upstash Redis
items.does: Event store behind the shared care state.

items.name: Vercel
items.does: Hosting and the AI Gateway.

items.name: Web Speech API
items.does: The browser reads the card aloud (speech synthesis).

everything.group: How we built it · Cómo lo construimos

items.name: Claude Code (Opus and Sonnet)
items.does: Coding agent for most app code, under human review.

items.name: Antigravity CLI (Gemini)
items.does: Second coding agent family, used for parallel work.

items.name: OpenCode
items.does: Coding agent that ran on free tier models.

items.name: Herdr
items.does: Terminal panes to run several agents side by side.

items.name: Hindsight
items.does: Self-hosted shared memory for all agents across our machines.

items.name: PioRelay
items.does: Agent to agent mailbox between our agents.

items.name: tokscale
items.does: Reads the agents' own logs and feeds the token numbers on this page.

items.name: Playwright and Vitest
items.does: End to end and unit tests.

items.name: edge-tts and ffmpeg
items.does: Synthetic voices and video processing for the demo audio.

items.name: GitHub
items.does: Source code and review.

items.name: Vercel
items.does: Builds and deploys every push.
